description: AddItem appends a new TODO item to a project and returns it with its id.

harness.description: harness is a preference such as "codex"; empty or "any" means none.

project.description: project is the heading to file the item under.

name: backlog_add_item

description: ListItems returns backlog items, optionally filtered by project, state and harness.

harness.description: harness keeps items this harness may run: its own plus "any"/unset.

state.description: state of UNSPECIFIED matches every state.

name: backlog_list_items

description: UpdateItem sets an item's state, claiming or releasing it.

claim.description: claim is required when state is CLAIMED.

by.description: by is "<sleeve>" or "<sleeve>/<harness>"; no whitespace or '@'.

id.description: id of the item to change.

state.description: state is the state to move the item to.

name: backlog_update_item

description: Compact runs the harness's own native compaction between turns. It fails with failed_precondition while a turn is running or an approval is pending, and returns after the harness has confirmed the compaction.
name: chat_compact

description: Interrupt cancels the running turn. It is a no-op when the harness is idle.
name: chat_interrupt

description: Respond answers a pending approval.
name: chat_respond

description: Send delivers a user message. It starts a turn when the harness is idle; during a turn it steers that turn on harnesses that support it and fails with failed_precondition on the rest. Retrying with the same request_id returns the original result instead of sending twice.
name: chat_send

description: GetStatus returns the hub version, host platform and uptime.
name: hub_get_status

description: CancelJob stops a job and its whole process tree, named by id or by the SubmitJob request_id. Cancelling a finished job is a no-op that returns its record.

id.description: id names the job. Set exactly one of id and request_id.

requestId.description: request_id names the job by the SubmitJob key, for a caller that never saw the response. A submit still in flight is awaited and then canceled. When no submit with the key has reached the hub, the key is remembered as canceled for 1h so a late submit is refused (aborted), and the call fails with not_found.

name: job_cancel_job

description: GetJob returns one job record.
name: job_get_job

description: ListJobs returns job records, newest first.

limit.description: limit caps the result; zero means 50.

state.description: state, when set, keeps only jobs in that state.

name: job_list_jobs

description: SubmitJob queues a job and returns at once with its id. Follow it with WatchJob.

artifactGlobs.description: artifact_globs select files, relative to the working directory, that are sent back to $PROTECTORATE_HOME/jobs/<id>/artifacts/. A glob that matches a directory takes the files below it.

command.description: command is the argv to execute; argv[0] is resolved on the node, relative to the working directory when it contains a path separator.

requestId.description: request_id is a client-chosen idempotency key, 8 to 128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._-]. The hub remembers it for 1h after the first submit with it: a repeat returns the same job instead of creating another, and waits if the first call is still in flight. Pick it with enough entropy to be unique among callers (a UUID or 16 random bytes in hex). With it, a caller that lost the response can still find or cancel the job (CancelJob request_id). Empty means no deduplication.

artifact.description: artifact runs in a fresh job directory holding the file.

path.description: path is a file or directory on the hub.

workdir.description: workdir is the directory, relative to the job directory, the command runs in; empty means the job directory itself. Directories only.

git.description: git checks the commit out in a per-repo worktree on the node that is reused by later jobs, so build caches stay warm.

commit.description: commit is any revision the repository resolves; empty means HEAD. The job record holds the full id.

repo.description: repo is a path to a git repository on the hub.

leaseId.description: lease_id runs on the node of a live lease (and on its GPU, if any).

selector.description: selector picks the least-loaded fresh matching node that is not leased.

gpuVramBytes.description: gpu_vram_bytes asks for one GPU with at least this much free VRAM; a lease then reserves that GPU instead of the whole node.

minFreeMemoryBytes.description: min_free_memory_bytes is the least available memory the node must report.

os.description: os and arch are Go GOOS/GOARCH values such as "windows" and "arm64".

timeout.description: timeout bounds the command's run time; zero means 1h, at most 24h.

name: job_submit_job

description: AcquireLease reserves one resource exclusively: a node name ("win1"), one GPU ("gpu-box:gpu1") or whatever a selector picks. A selector chooses the least-loaded fresh matching node that is not already leased.

allowFamily.description: allow_family admits nodes of tier "family", which are skipped otherwise.

holder.description: holder labels who holds the lease, e.g. a sleeve or agent name.

resource.description: resource is a node name or "<node>:gpu<index>".

gpuVramBytes.description: gpu_vram_bytes asks for one GPU with at least this much free VRAM; a lease then reserves that GPU instead of the whole node.

minFreeMemoryBytes.description: min_free_memory_bytes is the least available memory the node must report.

os.description: os and arch are Go GOOS/GOARCH values such as "windows" and "arm64".

ttl.description: ttl is how long the lease lives without a renewal; at most 24h.

name: lease_acquire_lease

description: ListLeases returns every live lease.
name: lease_list_leases

description: ReleaseLease frees a lease at once. Releasing an unknown or expired lease is an error.
name: lease_release_lease

description: RenewLease pushes the expiry of a live lease to now plus a TTL.

ttl.description: ttl replaces the lease's TTL; zero keeps the current one.

name: lease_renew_lease

description: GetNode returns one node with full metrics: filesystems, GPUs, containers, engine disk usage and watched directories.
name: node_get_node

description: ListNodes returns every node with its latest metrics summary, freshness and alerts.
name: node_list_nodes

description: RemoveNode removes a node from the hub inventory. It does not touch the machine itself.
name: node_remove_node

description: GetQuota returns the usage windows, resets and freshness of every provider subscription (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, local LLMs).

refresh.description: refresh forces an immediate read of each provider, rate-limited per provider; providers read too recently keep their cached data.

name: quota_get_quota

description: Suggest ranks the harnesses a sleeve can run (claude, codex, grok and pi) by usable spare capacity before reset, best first. Only FRESH quota data counts as capacity: STALE and UNKNOWN providers are listed as not recommended. A harness scores the capacity that is usable now (the tightest window) and expected to expire unused at a reset, weighted toward the sooner reset. pi on the local LLM has no quota and is always recommended as the fallback, ranked below any subscription with real capacity to burn. Antigravity has no sleeve harness and is not listed.

refresh.description: refresh forces an immediate quota read first, as in GetQuotaRequest.

taskSize.description: task_size is a hint for how much headroom the work needs; a harness with less usable capacity than that is not recommended. Unset means medium.

name: quota_suggest

description: CapturePane returns the current text of a session's active pane. It also works on exited sessions, which is how a crash is diagnosed. Include at least one history line to see the whole final screen of an exited session.

lines.description: Number of history lines above the visible screen to include. Values above 10000 are clamped to 10000.

name.description: name of the session to read.

name: session_capture_pane

description: KillSession terminates a session and every process in it. It also removes an exited session, discarding its final screen.

name.description: name of the session to kill.

name: session_kill_session

description: ListSessions returns all sessions, running and exited.
name: session_list_sessions

description: GetSleeve returns one sleeve with its latest resource usage.
name: sleeve_get_sleeve

description: KillSleeve stops a sleeve's harness and every process in its sandbox and forgets the sleeve. The workspace and the sleeve's home directory are kept on disk.
name: sleeve_kill_sleeve

description: ListSleeves returns every known sleeve, running or exited, with its latest resource usage.
name: sleeve_list_sleeves

description: SpawnSleeve starts a harness in a new isolated sleeve on the hub. The workspace is an existing directory (bound read-write at the same path) or a git URL cloned into the hub's workspaces directory. Respawning the name of an exited sleeve reuses its home directory and workspace and replaces its kept session.

args.description: args are extra arguments for the harness, or the whole command for shell.

env.description: env holds extra environment variables for the harness.

cpuPercent.description: cpu_percent caps CPU time; 100 is one core, 200 two cores. 0 means unlimited.

memoryBytes.description: memory_bytes caps memory including page cache and tmpfs; swap is disabled when set. 0 means unlimited.

name.description: name is 1-40 of a-z 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

workspace.description: workspace is an absolute directory path on the hub, or a git URL to clone.

name: sleeve_spawn_sleeve

description: GetStatus returns the hub's tailnet identity and every peer it knows. FAILED_PRECONDITION when the tailnet is not enabled on this hub.
name: tailnet_get_status
